capabilities.title: Product & Domain
capabilities.description: Establish the product outcome, users, domain language, invariants, and scope boundaries before delivery work begins.

controls.requirement: Target users, desired outcomes, in-scope behavior, exclusions, and success measures are explicit and reviewable.
Domain terminology, core entities, ownership boundaries, and business invariants are defined without conflicting meanings.

capabilities.title: Requirements & Acceptance
capabilities.description: Turn the requested outcome into bounded, testable behavior and explicit acceptance conditions.

controls.requirement: Functional requirements, constraints, assumptions, exclusions, and external dependencies are testable and traceable to the requested outcome.
Acceptance criteria cover critical success paths, negative paths, boundary cases, and externally blocked conditions.

capabilities.title: Quality Attributes
capabilities.description: Commission measurable non-functional targets and the failure behavior expected from the workload.

controls.requirement: Performance, scale, availability, security, privacy, accessibility, observability, and cost targets are explicit where applicable.
Critical failure modes, degraded behavior, recovery objectives, and unsafe outcomes are identified before implementation.

capabilities.title: Architecture & Boundaries
capabilities.description: Define the reference architecture, dependency direction, and trust boundaries that keep delivery work out of spaghetti paths.

controls.requirement: The reference architecture names modules, responsibilities, dependency direction, asynchronous boundaries, and the normal delivery path.
Data, identity, tenant, provider, network, runtime, and human-authority boundaries are explicit with named owners.

capabilities.title: Data & Transactions
capabilities.description: Establish authoritative data ownership and transaction invariants before features depend on them.

controls.requirement: Authoritative data sources, schemas, classification, retention, residency, deletion, migration, and recovery expectations are defined.
Transaction boundaries, consistency, idempotency, concurrency, ordering, reconciliation, and rollback rules are explicit and testable.

capabilities.title: Engineering & Test Strategy
capabilities.description: Define how changes are built, tested, reviewed, promoted, and kept maintainable.

controls.requirement: Coding standards, module boundaries, branch policy, environments, dependency policy, migration policy, and delivery commands are commissioned.
The test and evaluation strategy assigns appropriate unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, load, security, and domain proof to owned boundaries.

capabilities.title: Decisions, Ownership & Risk
capabilities.description: Make hard-to-reverse decisions, operational ownership, approval boundaries, and residual risk explicit.

controls.requirement: Hard-to-reverse product, architecture, data, provider, security, and operational decisions have owners, rationale, alternatives, and review triggers.
Known risks, Red Zone actions, approvers, escalation paths, runbooks, rollback ownership, and accepted residual risk are recorded.
